chars.AMIR: AMIR: a Moroccan man around 24, short black curly hair, light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black joggers and white sneakers
chars.NOUHAILA: NOUHAILA: a Moroccan young woman around 23, wearing a dusty-pink hijab, a long olive-green cardigan over a white top, round gold glasses
chars.MOTHER: MOTHER: Amir's Moroccan mother in her fifties, wearing a deep burgundy djellaba with gold embroidery and a cream headscarf
chars.FATHER: FATHER: Amir's Moroccan father around 60, grey moustache, wearing a brown wool djellaba and a white knitted taqiya cap

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a small modest Moroccan apartment living room, NOUHAILA proudly holds up her university diploma, smiling, while AMIR slumps on a worn sofa looking jealous and frustrated, the tension between them obvious. Both shown full body in the center of the frame.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: AMIR sits alone at a plastic table of a cheap Moroccan street cafe, scrolling job offers on his phone with a defeated, stressed face, an untouched glass of mint tea in front of him, evening light.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a traditional Moroccan family salon with banquettes, the tired FATHER holds a pile of unpaid bills with a worried face while the MOTHER looks at him anxiously, the room feels poorer and empty.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: AMIR lies on a thin mattress on the floor of a cramped Moroccan room at night, staring at the ceiling, daydreaming; a faint dreamy cloud above him shows a big white villa with a pool.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: NOUHAILA studies late at night at a small desk covered with thick books and notes under a desk lamp, determined and focused, in a modest Moroccan bedroom.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: AMIR stands pointing firmly at the apartment door, telling NOUHAILA to go out and get a job, while NOUHAILA sits at her desk with her books, turning to him shocked and offended. Moroccan apartment.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: AMIR furious, shouting with his arms wide open in the middle of a small Moroccan kitchen, while NOUHAILA stands back against the counter with her arms crossed, angry and hurt. Heated argument.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: NOUHAILA stands up face to face with AMIR in the living room and raises a finger in his face, giving him a serious ultimatum with a cold determined look, AMIR frozen and stunned. Dramatic tense moment.
